title: Nvidia discussed investing another $1 billion in Figure AI
source_used: Crypto Briefing (full text read; no outside credit in the text)
key_facts: Nvidia has discussed putting another $1 billion into Figure AI, a humanoid robotics startup founded by Brett Adcock in 2022; the talks are not confirmed and no terms have surfaced.
Nvidia joined Figure's Series C in September 2025; that round raised over $1 billion at a $39 billion post-money valuation.
Figure has raised about $1.9 billion in total; earlier backers include Microsoft, the OpenAI Startup Fund and Intel Capital.
Nvidia is a key technology provider for Helix, Figure's general-purpose AI model for its robots.

On 3 Sep 2026 Figure announced a partnership with Nscale: an initial $3.5 billion of compute capacity that can grow beyond $6 billion, with up to 100,000 Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs targeted from the second half of 2027 in Barstow, Texas.
Figure's stated bottlenecks are data and computing resources; the article says robots need physical-world data, not only text.
quote_evidence: Nvidia has discussed putting another $1 billion into Figure AI, the humanoid robotics startup founded by Brett Adcock in 2022.
The talks have not been confirmed, and no deal terms have surfaced.

why_it_matters_hint: Who funds humanoid robots and at what price; the $1 billion is a discussion, not a deal.
